description: This source file defines an interface `CachingSignalEnrichmentFacadeConfig` that provides configuration methods related to caching behavior in the signal enrichment service. It includes constants and an enumeration for default configuration values.

classes.name: CachingSignalEnrichmentFacadeConfig
classes.description: An interface for retrieving caching configuration related to signal enrichment, including cache duration and cache configuration.

classes.name: CachingSignalEnrichmentFacadeConfig.CachingSignalEnrichmentFacadeConfigValue
classes.description: Enumeration of known configuration values with defaults for the signal enrichment cache settings.

methods.name: getAskTimeout
methods.description: Returns the timeout duration for cache retrievals.

methods.name: getCacheConfig
methods.description: Returns the cache configuration to apply for each connection scoped signal enrichment cache.

methods.name: getDefaultValue
methods.description: Returns the default value for a given configuration parameter.

methods.name: getConfigPath
methods.description: Returns the configuration path string for a known configuration value.
